discription: A bright and piercing saw wave lead sound with a fast attack and quick decay, good for sharp melodic phrases.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, attack=0.005, decay=0.2, sustain=0.0, release=0.3, detune=0.001;var sig, env;env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(attack, decay, sustain, release, curve: -4),gate: gate,doneAction: 2);sig = (Saw.ar(freq) + Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune))) * 0.5;sig = sig * amp * env;Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, 0, 1));}
